title: AC1024 architectural named-block SORTENTSTABLE DXF owner-scope boundary

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local DWG, author and producer unauthenticated; the file is untracked in this checkout and was not added to Git.

authority.source: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference 2020 ENU, SORTENTSTABLE
authority.rule: SORTENTSTABLE body group 330 is a soft-pointer owner reference currently limited to the *MODEL_SPACE or *PAPER_SPACE blocks. DRAWORDER stores the table under ACAD_SORTENTS in a space block's extension dictionary.
authority.decision: Named-block owner tables are outside the documented DXF profile. Internal writer/readback agreement does not establish a valid owner role. Keep their opaque callbacks unqualified and strict whole-file output refused.

sourceInventory.note: The first four named-block dictionaries contain the source-witnessed ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK, ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCK and/or purge-preventer graph entries. These identities do not widen the DXF SORTENTSTABLE body-owner schema.

currentStrictOutput.result: FAIL CLOSED at finalization: 484/490 opaque callbacks qualified; the six named-block SORTENTSTABLE identities above remain unqualified; no DXF was published.

discardedExperiment.result: A temporary qualification-only relaxation let this source convert in ASCII and Binary and pass libdxfrw typed readback. The output is not counted as valid evidence because its named-block group-330 owners conflict with Autodesk's documented DXF restriction. All experimental source and test edits were reverted.

existingModelPaperRegression.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary; 88 ordered mappings, atomic refusal, same-adapter retry and fresh typed readback.

planImpact.resolved: The architectural named-block SORTENTSTABLE candidate is ineligible for DXF output under the cited owner schema. Do not implement or claim named-block table output based only on local writer/readback consistency.
planImpact.retainedBoundary: Only *MODEL_SPACE and *PAPER_SPACE owner profiles may qualify; the six named-block callbacks remain open/refused.
planImpact.next: Continue P4 with the AC1027 Cover source-bound callback/reference closure. Keep the independent unclaimed-header-suffix gate closed, and only qualify a selected graph whose every emitted owner/target role is valid under DXF schema.
